title.zh: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
title.en: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters

current_state.zh: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency in federal court, alleging the agency exceeded its legal authority by granting national trust bank charters to crypto firms and thereby giving them an unfair competitive advantage over traditional banks.
current_state.en: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency in federal court, alleging the agency exceeded its legal authority by granting national trust bank charters to crypto firms and thereby giving them an unfair competitive advantage over traditional banks.
